description: Hydropower 2017, ICEM (International Centre for Environmental Management) Prod2 is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by The Asia Foundation. This is the Hydropower data from the Hydropower & Dams part of the ICEM (International Centre for Environmental Management). Coverage: the Mekong region (Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam). The portal files it under the publisher The Asia Foundation. Its tags are Aid and development, Energy. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, txt, xlsx. The portal shows 2019-05-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is unspecified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
